item.description: The RLP encoding implementation has several issues. First, it's trying to use the external 'rlp' package which is not installed, causing ModuleNotFoundError. Second, the RLP encoding logic is incomplete and incorrect, causing various encoding/decoding failures. The implementation also has issues with hex conversion and handling of different data types.
item.contract: Fix the RLP encoding/decoding implementation to properly handle all test cases without requiring the external 'rlp' package. The implementation must correctly encode integers, addresses, and lists according to the RLP standard, and handle hex string conversions properly.

item.description: The keccak_256 import is failing because hashlib doesn't have keccak_256 attribute. The implementation relies on pycryptodome which provides keccak functionality, but the current implementation isn't properly using it.
item.contract: Implement proper keccak hashing using the pycryptodome library that's already declared as a dependency. Replace the current placeholder implementation with a working keccak implementation that handles both text and binary data.

item.description: Some cryptographic functions are currently stubbed out with placeholder implementations that don't match the expected behavior in tests. These include signature recovery, private key to public key derivation, and transaction hash functions.
item.contract: Implement proper cryptographic functions that match the expected behavior in the test cases. This includes signature recovery, public key derivation, and transaction hash calculation.

item.description: The RLP encoding implementation has logic errors in handling different data types, particularly when dealing with address/nonce tuples and integer encodings. Some test cases are failing due to incorrect prefix calculations and data length handling.
item.contract: Fix the RLP encoding implementation to properly handle address/nonce tuples and integer encodings according to the RLP specification. Ensure all test cases in test_rlp_encoding.py pass.

item.description: There is no formats.py file, but the code tries to import from it. This leads to import errors in various parts of the codebase.
item.contract: Create a proper formats.py module that implements the necessary conversion functions for binary data formats (prefix_hex, raw_hex, etc.) that are referenced throughout the codebase.
item.acceptance: Import and usage of formats module throughout the binary module
